# NexGen Lead Groups

> Free, donation-based leads groups (referral groups) headquartered in Denver, Colorado. One seat per trade per group, Power Pairs matched by shared customers and trigger moments, a 45-minute weekly virtual exchange and an optional monthly in-person meetup. Colorado is the first live state.

## Groups
- [Colorado](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/colorado/): Denver Metro, Colorado Springs and Fort Collins groups forming
- [Denver Metro](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/colorado/denver-metro/)
- [Colorado Springs](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/colorado/colorado-springs/)
- [Fort Collins](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/colorado/fort-collins/)
- [Claim your state](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/claim-your-state/): all other states open to a founding leader

## How it works
- [How it works](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/how-it-works/): trigger moments, Power Pairs, weekly exchange format
- [What is a leads group?](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/leads-groups/)
- [Virtual leads groups](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/virtual-leads-group/)
- [Contribution Code](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/contribution-code/): free membership; seats depend on participation

## Free tools
- [Power Pair board](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/power-pairs/)
- [Idea Machine](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/tools/idea-machine/)
- [Who Do I Know](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/tools/who-do-i-know/)
- [Lead Card](https://www.nexgenleadgroups.com/tools/lead-card/)

## Facts
- Cost: free, no dues; optional donations (not tax-deductible)
- Weekly meeting: 45 minutes online (5 wins, 15 ask rounds, 15 Power Pair huddles, 10 hot seat)
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638, info@eyetoad.com, 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204
- Data cited on the site: SBA Office of Advocacy 2025 Small Business Profiles; U.S. Census Bureau 2020 Census
